biothings.name: gastric ulcer
biothings.definition: An ulcerated lesion in the mucosal surface of the stomach. It may progress to involve the deeper layers of the gastric wall. [NCIT:P378]
biothings.synonyms: gastric ulcer, gastric ulcer (disease), peptic ulcer disease of stomach, stomach peptic ulcer disease

opentargets.name: gastric ulcer
opentargets.description: An ulcerated lesion in the mucosal surface of the stomach. It may progress to involve the deeper layers of the gastric wall.

opentargets.name: peptic ulcer disease
opentargets.description: A digestive system disease characterized by discontinuation in the inner lining of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract because of gastric acid secretion or pepsin.

opentargets.name: duodenal ulcer
opentargets.description: An ulcer in the duodenal wall.

opentargets.name: esophageal ulcer
opentargets.description: An ulcerated lesion in the esophageal wall.

opentargets.name: ulcer disease
opentargets.description: A lesion on the surface of the skin or a mucous surface, produced by the sloughing of inflammatory necrotic tissue.
